name: Bubble Level
description: A free online bubble level and spirit level that checks how far any surface is from level, in degrees, using the tilt sensors your browser already exposes.
longDescription: Bubble Level is a level checker that runs in the browser: put the phone or tablet flat on the surface you want to test and a dot moves inside a bullseye vial as the surface tilts, with X and Y angles in degrees underneath. A calibrate button records the current position as zero, which matters because a phone case, a camera bump or a slightly uneven table all shift the reading; reset brings the raw sensor values back. The vial can go fullscreen so it is readable from a distance, and nothing is uploaded — the tilt stream is read on the device.
pricingDetails: Free — no sign-up, no usage limit, no paid tier. Tilt readings stay in the browser.
features: Bullseye vial with a moving dot that reacts to tilt as you watch
X and Y angles in degrees, updated every frame
Calibrate button records the current position as 0.0° (saved between visits)
Reset button returns to the raw sensor values
Fullscreen vial for reading a surface from a step back
No install, no account; nothing about the surface is uploaded
useCases: Checking whether a table, shelf or desk is level before loading it
Levelling a picture frame, a shelf bracket or a wall-mounted TV
Testing a washing machine, fridge or treadmill for a stable footing
Quick tilt check on a caravan, a tent shelf or a shop display
